questions.question: When an Israelite brought an animal as an offering to the LORD, where could the animal come from?
Why did an Israelite lay his hand on the head of his burnt offering before the LORD?

answers.text: So it could make atonement for him
So the priest would know it was his
So the animal would stay calm at the altar

questions.question: When an Israelite brought a grain offering, the priest burned a handful on the altar. What happened to the rest?

answers.text: It belonged to Aaron and his sons
It went back to the man who brought it
It was burned the next morning
